DIAGNOSIS READY: Temporal Lobe Epilepsy (likely Mesial Temporal Lobe onset).

The clinical presentation of staring spells, nonresponsiveness, oral automatism (grimacing/muddy taste), and post-ictal confusion in a 7-year-old is classic for a focal impaired awareness seizure, often originating in the temporal lobe. Given the high specificity of these symptoms, no further questioning is required to confirm the diagnosis.
